prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: production animation sprite atlas for a tiny inline website woodcut.
Input image 1: bus design/style reference. Keep the same red modern London New Routemaster model, mature red/black/cream linocut texture and front-right three-quarter view.
Create exactly FIFTEEN bus animation frames, uniformly packed into exactly FIVE COLUMNS and THREE ROWS on a genuinely transparent background. Wide landscape canvas, ideally 2000x1200. Each of the 15 equal rectangular cells holds one complete bus, centered and entirely contained with safe empty margins. There are five buses in every row; no extra or missing buses. Frame sequence is left-to-right row 1, then row 2, then row 3. No visible cell dividers or borders.
Animation: a short seamless drive-in-place cycle. Wheels visibly rotate via bold cream hub markings; chassis performs one deliberate gentle but visible suspension bob and slight forward lean, then returns to its original stance. Chassis lifts by about 6% of bus height at the peak, with max 3-degree lean. Keep the same bus, fixed camera, consistent scale, horizontal registration and nominal ground baseline. Movement is within each cell, not across the sheet. Frame 1 and frame 15 match the original resting stance closely; intermediate frames smoothly change wheel rotation and suspension. Motion must read when a bus is shown only 45px wide.
Keep recognizable model details in EVERY frame: rounded sculptural red roof, swept diagonal black staircase glass along the side, curved large windshield, circular headlight clusters, two visible wheels. Flat hand-printed red ink, charcoal black, warm cream negative-space cut marks. Mature editorial woodcut, not 3D, not childish. Preserve broad graphic silhouette and simplify minor textures enough for tiny rendering. No faces, cute eyes, people, roads, shadows, sky, smoke, exhaust, scenery, text, labels, numbering, grid lines or background colors. Actual transparent alpha in all blank space. Fifteen individual complete drawings in exactly 5 columns x3 rows.
CRITICAL CORRECTIONS FROM THE PRIOR ATTEMPT: Allocate substantial transparent space around EACH bus. Every equal cell is square, 1/5 of canvas width by1/3 of canvas height. Each bus must fill only75% of its cell width and60% of its cell height. Thus at least12.5% transparent padding on left and right of EVERY cell. Never touch or cross cell boundaries. Align all bus centers exactly on an evenly spaced grid; do not use a collage. Vertical cell centers at 1/6, 3/6 and5/6 canvas height. Horizontal centers at 1/10,3/10,5/10,7/10,9/10 canvas width. This blank space is essential.
Make changes MORE VISIBLE: wheel hub cream spokes rotate by24degrees each frame; bright cream headlight discs illuminate gradually across frames4–8 then fade across9–13; suspension rises and falls by10% of bus height, and3degreelean. The bus should look like it is driving, not fifteen indistinguishable copies. Keep the same scale and registration, and avoid shaking or incidental drawing drift.
notes: Generated PNG copied unchanged. Fifteen frames visually verified. Final sprite packing may crop cell padding and align scale/ground baseline mechanically without redrawing. Visible changes: rotating cream wheel markings, suspension rocking, headlamp illumination and dimming.
